name: Lady Guildenstern
message: I don't want to reach my hand in there. This fountain probably hasn't been cleaned since Ogier the Dane was alive!

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: Well, I don't want to get my hands dirty, either.

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: We'll need to choose by some sort of objective, reasonable criteria.

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: For example: Age. I'm older, so I say you have to put your hand in the fountain.

name: Lady Guildenstern
message: Well, I can't argue with that logic.

name: Lady Guildenstern
message: And it's all over my hand...

name: Lady Guildenstern
message: Do you think this much is enough?

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: I can't see ever needing any more. Blech.

name: Lady Rosencrantz
message: Let's go. Quickly, before anyone more sees us making uncomely idiots of ourselves.
